{{2021–22 Big Ten Conference men's basketball standings}}
The '''2021–22 Purdue Boilermakers men's basketball team''' represented [[Purdue University]] in the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. Their head coach was [[Matt Painter]] in his 17th season with the Boilermakers. The Boilermakers played their home games at [[Mackey Arena]] in [[West Lafayette, Indiana]] as members of the [[Big Ten Conference]].

On December 6, 2021, Purdue was ranked No. 1 in the [[AP Poll|AP poll]] for the first time in school history, receiving all 61 first-place votes.<ref>{{Cite news|last=Fezler|first=D. J.|title=Unbeaten Purdue Basketball Takes No. 1 Spot in AP Top 25 Poll, First Time in School History|url=https://www.si.com/college/purdue/basketball/unbeaten-purdue-basketball-takes-no-1-spot-in-ap-top-25-poll-first-time-in-school-history|access-date=2021-12-07|website=Sports Illustrated|language=en}}</ref> They were also ranked No. 1 in the [[Coaches Poll|Coaches poll]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=College basketball rankings: Purdue jumps to No. 1 in Coaches Poll, giving Boilermakers sweep of major polls|url=https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/news/college-basketball-rankings-purdue-jumps-to-no-1-in-coaches-poll-giving-boilermakers-sweep-of-major-polls/|access-date=2021-12-07|website=CBSSports.com|date=6 December 2021 |language=en}}</ref>

==Previous season==
In a season limited due to the ongoing [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]], the [[2020–21 Purdue Boilermakers men's basketball team|Boilermakers]] finished the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2020–21 season]] 18–10, 13–6 in [[2020–21 Big Ten Conference men's basketball season|Big Ten play]] to finish in fourth place.<ref>{{Cite web|title=2020-21 Purdue Boilermakers Schedule and Results|url=https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/schools/purdue/2021-schedule.html|access-date=2021-12-07|website=College Basketball at Sports-Reference.com|language=en}}</ref> They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2021 Big Ten men's basketball tournament|Big Ten tournament]] to [[2020–21 Ohio State Buckeyes men's basketball team|Ohio State]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2021 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 4 seed in the South region, where they were upset in the first round by No. 13-seeded [[2020–21 North Texas Mean Green men's basketball team|North Texas]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=North Texas vs. Purdue - Game Summary - March 19, 2021 - ESPN|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/game/_/gameId/401310909|access-date=2021-12-07|website=ESPN.com|language=en}}</ref>
